blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 1,240 examinees passed the November 2026 Nutritionist Dietitian licensure examination, the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Thursday. This is 83 percent out of the total of the 1,477 aspirants who took the exam.
